mapper.sql: c.customer_id, c.organization_id, o.name_masked AS organization_name, c.customer_code, c.customer_alias, c.classification, c.status, c.created_at, c.created_by, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, c.deleted_at, c.deleted_by, c.version

where.if: AND ( LOWER(c.customer_code) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(c.customer_alias) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') )

choose.when: AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND o.status = 'ACTIVE' AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
AND c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND c.status = 'DELETED'

mapper.select: SELECT FROM tbl_dim_customer c LEFT JOIN tbl_dim_organization o ON o.organization_id = c.organization_id WHERE c.customer_id = #{customerId}

SELECT FROM tbl_dim_customer c INNER JOIN tbl_dim_organization o ON o.organization_id = c.organization_id
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.customer_code ASC OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_dim_customer c INNER JOIN tbl_dim_organization o ON o.organization_id = c.organization_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_dim_customer ( customer_id, organization_id, customer_code, customer_alias, classification, status, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, deleted_at, deleted_by, version ) VALUES ( #{customerId}, #{organizationId}, #{customerCode}, #{customerAlias}, #{classification}::text, #{status}::record_status, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{deletedAt}, #{deletedBy}, #{version} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_dim_customer SET organization_id = #{organizationId}, customer_code = #{customerCode}, customer_alias = #{customerAlias}, classification = #{classification}::text, status = #{status}::record_status, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL

WITH target_customer AS ( SELECT customer_id FROM tbl_dim_customer WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL ), target_projects AS ( SELECT project_id FROM tbl_dim_project WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM target_customer) ), updated_projects AS ( UPDATE tbl_dim_project SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE project_id IN (SELECT project_id FROM target_projects) AND status <> 'DELETED' RETURNING project_id ), target_repositories AS ( SELECT repository_id FROM tbl_dim_repository WHERE project_id IN (SELECT project_id FROM target_projects) ), updated_repositories AS ( UPDATE tbl_dim_repository SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE repository_id IN (SELECT repository_id FROM target_repositories) AND status <> 'DELETED' RETURNING repository_id ), updated_tickets AS ( UPDATE tbl_dim_ticket SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE project_id IN (SELECT project_id FROM target_projects) AND status <> 'CANCELLED' RETURNING ticket_id ), disabled_project_roles AS ( UPDATE tbl_auth_member_project_role SET active_flag = FALSE, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE project_id IN (SELECT project_id FROM target_projects) AND active_flag = TRUE RETURNING member_key ), disabled_access_scopes AS ( UPDATE tbl_auth_member_access_scope SET active_flag = FALSE, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM target_customer) OR project_id IN (SELECT project_id FROM target_projects) OR repository_id IN (SELECT repository_id FROM target_repositories) RETURNING access_scope_id ) UPDATE tbl_dim_customer SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM target_customer)
